main.summary: Implements segmented transfer on top of staged DataServices storage.

field.name: Coordinator
field.summary: Coordinates item-scoped and session-scoped mutation locks across transfer operations.

field.name: Options
field.summary: Runtime options controlling segment policy clamping and temporary payload staging behavior.

field.name: PublishedSource
field.summary: Loads committed published snapshots used to seed and backfill read-oriented transfer sessions.

field.name: Registry
field.summary: Finds existing segmented or stream writer conflicts for an item to prevent conflicting upload sessions.

field.name: Storage
field.summary: Persists staged manifests, object payloads, and segmented stream content.

method.name: CreateManifest
method.summary: Create the initial staged transfer manifest for a newly opened session.

method.name: CreateCommittedReadManifest
method.summary: Create a read-committed session manifest from a published snapshot.

method.name: CreateRange
method.summary: Create a transfer range from an offset and length pair.

method.name: EnumerateStoredManifests
method.summary: Enumerate retained segmented session manifests that satisfy the optional inspection filters.

method.name: CreateStagedReadManifest
method.summary: Create a read-staged session manifest derived from another staged source session.

method.name: ClampPolicy
method.summary: Clamp a requested segment-size policy against the configured service default policy.
method.returns: Effective validated policy used for the session.

method.name: LoadRequiredManifest
method.summary: Load and normalize the manifest required for an operation.

method.name: MatchesSessionFilter
method.summary: Determine whether a retained segmented manifest matches the requested inspection filters.
method.returns: True when the manifest matches the requested filters.

method.name: LoadRequiredPublishedSnapshot
method.summary: Load and validate the published snapshot required for committed-read operations.

method.name: ToServerSessionInfo
method.summary: Map a retained segmented manifest to the server inspection record shape.
method.returns: Server inspection record for the retained segmented session.

method.name: MapFailureCode
method.summary: Map a canonical failure message to the corresponding segmented transfer failure code.

method.name: ValidateAbortRequest
method.summary: Validate the abort request shape.

method.name: ValidateCommitRequest
method.summary: Validate the commit request shape.

method.name: ValidateGetTransferSegmentRequest
method.summary: Validate the transfer-segment read request shape.

method.name: ValidateHashBytes
method.summary: Validate that two SHA-512 hash values are equal.

method.name: ValidateHashPayloadAsync
method.summary: Validate a SHA-512 hash against a readable payload stream asynchronously with cancellation support.

method.name: ValidateHashPayloadStreamAsync
method.summary: Validate a SHA-512 hash against exactly the declared number of bytes from a readable payload stream.
method.param: Expected number of payload bytes that belong to the segment.

method.name: ValidateManifestHashes
method.summary: Validate reopen request hashes and stream length against the stored manifest.
method.param: Expected object hash from the request.
Expected stream hash from the request.
Expected stream length from the request.

method.name: ValidateManifestIdentity
method.summary: Validate that a manifest belongs to the requested session and item identifiers.

method.name: ValidateOpenRequest
method.summary: Validate the open request shape and object payload hash.

method.name: ValidateOpenGetRequest
method.summary: Validate the open-read request shape and optional staged source session identifier.

method.name: ValidatePublishedSnapshot
method.summary: Validate a published snapshot before it is used to seed or serve committed-read sessions.

method.name: ValidateReOpenGetRequest
method.summary: Validate the reopen-read request shape and expected stream hash.

method.name: ValidateReOpenRequest
method.summary: Validate the reopen request shape.

method.name: ValidateSegmentLengthAgainstPolicy
method.summary: Validate a segment length against the effective session segment-size policy and enforcement options.
method.param: Stored manifest containing the effective segment policy.

method.name: ValidateSegmentHash
method.summary: Validate a segment hash against a segment payload.
method.param: Expected number of bytes in the segment payload.

method.name: ValidateSessionReadable
method.summary: Validate that the current session status permits read-oriented operations.

method.name: ValidateSessionWritable
method.summary: Validate that the current session status permits write-oriented operations.

method.name: ValidatePutTransferSegmentRequest
method.summary: Validate the segment write request shape and payload length.

main.summary: Provides a seekable staged payload wrapper for upload segments, buffering to a temporary file when the incoming stream is not seekable.

property.name: Stream
property.summary: Seekable payload stream positioned and owned by the wrapper.

constructor.name: SeekablePayloadBuffer
constructor.summary: Create the wrapper around a seekable payload stream.
constructor.param: Seekable stream owned by the wrapper.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create a seekable payload wrapper by reusing the source stream or staging it to a temporary file.
method.param: Optional configured directory for temporary staged uploads.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Dispose the wrapped stream and any temporary staged resources it owns.
